info.text: Elise returned to the Imperial Temple to tell them of Viscount Remus, but she has already sent a message back. Apparently a large rift, the Bretheran Abyss has opened not far from here.
It is at the entrance to the Murken Forest. A dense fog has engulfed the area making it very damp and dark. It is sure to be filled with beasts!
I can feel the evil energy of the abyss. We have certainly found the right place!
Let's gather evidence as quickly as possible and then report back to the Imperial Temple.
Who are you? What are you doing here?
We are guardians of the mighty Yaros! You have already entered the abyss!
Yaros? He has not been seen or heard from since the fall of Aklorn and Ibalize. Are you saying he has returned?
It seems the situation has gotten worse. Maybe this rift is being caused by the Void Magic like you feared, Dinah. We must head into the forest to investigate at once!
Hehehehehe. You can't possibly expect to get through here. The void is opening...OPENING! We feed off of it! Hehehehe! It will soon engulf the whole world!

info.text: The Roaring Wetlands is one of the most dangerous areas of the Murken Forest. It's crawling with wild beasts and evil creatures.
The wild beasts in this area have all been infected by evil energy and crave the blood of humans.
Let's get past this area as quickly as possible. The source of this evil is bound to be deep inside the forest.

info.text: We have made it all the way to the Duskin Arena. Imperial High Commander Balderon and hundreds of thousands of other brave warriors have lost their lives here.

I remember hearing stories about the ghosts that haunt the Duskin Arena as a child. In my village, mothers would use the ghost stories to make naughtly children behave. 'Be good, or the Ghost of Balderon will come for you.'
In my experince, most 'stories' grow from at least an element of truth.
Let's be cautious and get out of here quickly.

info.text: ......urgh......damn this Void Stuff! Release me so I may follow my ancestors into the hereafter!

We must try and help him escape from the Void Stuff. Then maybe he can rest in peace.

info.text: Careful, Dinah. The forest ahead is very dense. It is nearly impossible to see ahead or what may be lurking in the forest around us.
The road ahead is most likely full of traps. Watch where you step!
True, but according to the message from Elise, this is the only way to reach the village on the other side. We will need to sneak through.
Look, it's Sonja the Sage! She was one of the greatest masters from the Imperial Temple, but has been missing for quite some time. What is she doing here?

*cackles* Welcome to the abyss, my pretties! Dinah, I am so glad that you have joined me here! Bow down to the mighty Yaros and be blessed with his immortal power. Or, dare to refuse him, and feel his almighty wrath!
Oh no! She has already become a puppet of Yaros and the evil Void. All those traps we ran into must have been set by her!
Submit! Submit and die!
Don't you mean 'submit or die?'
I know what I said!

info.text: We've finally arrived at Edena Village. All the surviving forest dwellers were supposed to gather here and wait for help.
'Edena Village?' An awfully peaceful name for a village in the middle of that hellish Murken Forest.

It was once considered a safe haven for people who needed to travel through the forest. But it looks as though the village may have finally caved under the evil forces amassing in the forest. How tragic.
Let's keep looking. We may still find surviors.
Arrghh... I can't fight it any more!
Eletos!
Dinah, stay back! This warrior has been infected by the Void magic! Do you know him?
He is a famed imperial swordsman. And a good...friend. Please! Wake up, Eletos!
Ah! My dear, Dinah! You have arrived just in time! Now you must bow to my collosal power!
Oh...Eletos...

info.text: Dinah, are you OK? That man, he was your friend?
Yes, just a friend. I think before this is over, we will all lose many friends.
Dinah, if you are not telling me something...
Dear warrior, please, trust me. I will not lead you astray. Now here, I believe we are getting very close to the opening of the Void.
This place is called Termini Cliff and is known for being a playground of the Dead and Undead. It is no surprise the Void is opening near this place.
Well, let's see if we can get closer and find the opening to the Void.

info.text: Yaros!
This is Yaros? He has not been seen since the fall of Aklorn. Is this where he has been hiding?
I am Merloch, the spirit of the Almighty Yaros, the King of Destruction! Come forth and challenge me! Your defeated soul will give me strength!
In the name of Aklorn, I will pass this test!
Muahahahaha! You underestimate the power of the Void! Let me show you it's true power, weakling!

info.text: Elise! Good to see you again, my friend. Do you have news from the Imperial Temple?
Yes, the Imperial Temple has learned that Yaros and his Void Army have indeed reappeared in the world.
We have already crossed paths with Merloch, the Spirit of Yaros - now it is time to find the real Yaros.
The Imperial Temple has ordered us to enter the Fetid Swamp to determine the true whereabouts of Yaros.

The defining moment of the human race was when Aklorn gave his life to defeat Ibalize to hold back the forces of Yaros. I cannot allow Yaros to walk in the world once more and have Aklorn's sacrifce be made in vain. I will avenge Aklorn if it is the last thing I do.
Spoken like a true hero.
